name: Gemini Audio MCP
description: High-performance AI audio, music, and voice generation using Gemini 2.5 and Lyria 3.
longDescription: The Gemini Audio MCP server brings enterprise-grade audio generation to your AI assistant. Powered by Gemini 2.5 Native Audio and Google's Lyria 3 music models, it allows for high-fidelity soundscape generation, expressive text-to-speech with voice direction, and full-length music production. Featuring seamless 100ms crossfade looping, direct FFmpeg piping for zero-latency encoding, and support for 10+ audio formats (MP3, WAV, FLAC, OPUS, etc.). Perfect for game developers, RPG players, and productivity tools.
author: jxoesneon
